title: 第11章 收获颇丰第12章 练气一层
content_zh:
“怎么了，这里不让修炼吗？”韩林疑惑地站起身来。
赵锐凌冷哼一声：“当然！这里可是我的私人修炼之地。”
私人修炼之地？
韩林只觉得此人是在故意找茬。
不过据说此人已经是练气二层，马上就要突破练气三层，成为正式弟子了，而且还有诸多追随者。
他暗暗权衡了一下，还是没有跟对方继续争辩，微微低头道：“抱歉赵师兄，我不知道这是你的地方，我这就走。”
“走？”
赵锐凌伸手拦住韩林，冷笑道：“吸收了我的灵气，就想离开，哪有那么便宜的事情！”
“你想怎么样？”
“赔我五十点积分，这事就这么算了，不然老子打死你！”
营地内虽然不准斗殴，但营地外可以啊，到时说是切磋时不小心误伤就行了，反正他又不是没干过。
韩林见对方不像开玩笑，不由往后退了两步，“我没有积分。”
“呵呵，没有积分不要紧！我可以让你先欠着，不过你最好早点还，不然每个月收你百分百的利息！”
见韩林服软，赵锐凌顿时笑了起来。
对于韩林这种新人，他自有一套收拾的办法，不是不给我打工吗，那就欠我高利贷好了，利滚利，让你一辈子都还不起！
说着，他取出事先准备好的纸笔，朝韩林递了过来：“写吧！”
“我的耐心有限，你最好不要犹豫。另外你也别想着跑，就算你跑了这一次，除非你以后都躲在营地不出来，不然，本公子有的是办法收拾你！”
“好，我写就是。”
韩林一咬牙，满脸不情愿地提笔书写起来。
正月二十六，赵锐凌向我借五十积分，月复利十成……。

写完，他将借条递给赵锐凌。
“算你识趣，滚吧。”赵锐凌看也不看，就将借条折叠，揣进怀里。
“谢赵师兄。”
韩林深深弯腰，然后快步离开，朝河对岸的矿洞走去。
下午，韩林依旧在原本的矿洞，继续向着深处挖掘，同时检查两侧的石壁内部，似乎他真的运气不错，这石壁内部，青花玉简直层出不穷。
等到傍晚收工时，韩林再次收获了六十多积分，让那位回收青花玉的汪庆中，愈发觉得不可思议。
他这一天就收获了上百积分。
傍晚回到营地，直接到百货坊，用一百积分，兑换了一颗灵石。
蓝灿灿的，个头跟鸡蛋般大小。
然后回到自己住所，迫不及待地激活通天法界，开始炼化起来。
才刚开始吸收，韩林就忍不住惊叹。
“真不愧是大家都眼红的灵石！这效果，比吸收自然灵气强太多了！”
这灵石内的灵气相当磅礴，比起石屋内稀薄的灵气来说，完全不是一个档次。
更重要的是，灵石这东西，只要其灵气没有被耗尽，就能一直吸收，不必像之前，吸收一轮还要等待其慢慢恢复。
通天法界内四个时辰。
韩林丹田之中便已经充斥着满满的真气，而这颗灵石的损耗，估计才三分之一不到。
他将灵石放在身前，然后法诀一转，将真气凝聚成归元劲。
朝着关卡壁障冲击而去。
咚！
刚猛的归元劲仿佛一根大铁棍，狠狠撞在关卡壁障上，发出只有韩林自己能听到的巨响，震的他气血翻腾。

他从未打过如此富裕的仗。
content_en:
"What's wrong, aren't you allowed to practice here?" Han Lin stood up in confusion.
Zhao Ruiling snorted: "Of course! This is my private training place."
A private training place?
Han Lin only felt that this person was deliberately looking for trouble.
However, it is said that this person is already at the second level of Qi training and will soon break through to the third level of Qi training and become a formal disciple, and he has many followers.
He weighed it secretly, but still did not continue to argue with the other party. He lowered his head slightly and said, "I'm sorry, Brother Zhao, I didn't know this was your place. I'll leave now."
"Go?"
Zhao Ruiling stretched out her hand to stop Han Lin and sneered: "You just want to leave after absorbing my spiritual energy. How can it be so cheap!"
"What do you want?"
"You'll pay me fifty points and let this be settled, or I'll beat you to death!"
Although fighting is not allowed in the camp, it is allowed outside the camp. It will be fine if it is an accidental injury during the sparring. Anyway, it is not like he has never done it before.
Seeing that the other party didn't seem to be joking, Han Lin couldn't help but take two steps back, "I don't have any points."
"Haha, it doesn't matter if you don't have points! I can let you owe it first, but you'd better pay it back early, otherwise I'll charge you 100% interest every month!"
Seeing Han Lin relent, Zhao Ruiling suddenly laughed.
For newcomers like Han Lin, he has his own way of dealing with it. If you don't work for me, then you owe me a loan shark. The interest will compound and you won't be able to pay it back in your lifetime!
With that said, he took out the paper and pen he had prepared in advance and handed it to Han Lin: "Write!"
"My patience is limited, you'd better not hesitate. Also, don't even think about running away. Even if you run away this time, unless you hide in the camp and never come out, I will have many ways to deal with you!"
"Okay, I'll just write."
Han Lin gritted his teeth and started writing with reluctance.
On the twenty-sixth day of the first lunar month, Zhao Ruiling borrowed 50 points from me, with monthly compound interest of 10%...
After writing it, he handed the IOU to Zhao Ruiling.
"You're smart, go away." Zhao Ruiling folded the IOU without even looking at it and put it in his arms.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Zhao."
Han Lin bent down deeply, then quickly left, heading towards the mine on the other side of the river.
In the afternoon, Han Lin continued to dig deeper in the original mine, and at the same time inspected the inside of the stone walls on both sides. It seemed that he was really lucky. Inside the stone walls, blue and white jade appeared endlessly.
When the work ended in the evening, Han Lin once again gained more than 60 points, which made Wang Qingzhong, who recovered the blue and white jade, even more incredible.
He gained hundreds of points this day.
Returning to the camp in the evening, I went directly to the department store and exchanged 100 points for a spiritual stone.
It's bright blue and as big as an egg.
Then he returned to his residence and couldn't wait to activate the Tongtian Dharma Realm and start refining it.
As soon as he started to absorb it, Han Lin couldn't help but marvel.
"It is indeed the spiritual stone that everyone is jealous of! This effect is much stronger than absorbing natural spiritual energy!"
The spiritual energy in this spiritual stone is quite majestic, and compared to the thin spiritual energy in the stone house, it is not at the same level.
What's more important is that as long as the spirit energy of the spirit stone is not exhausted, it can be absorbed continuously. There is no need to wait for it to slowly recover after absorbing it for a round like before.
There are four hours in Tongtian Dharma Realm.
Han Lin's dantian was already filled with true energy, and the loss of this spiritual stone was estimated to be less than one-third.
He placed the spirit stone in front of him, and then turned the magic formula to condense the true energy into Guiyuan Jin.
Rush towards the level barrier.
Boom!
The fierce Guiyuan Jin was like a big iron rod, slamming into the barrier of the level, making a loud noise that only Han Lin could hear, making his blood boil.
He had never fought so richly.
